era1_para: Church Of The Living God began with a handful of believers gathering in a living room, united by prayer and a shared conviction to build a church rooted in the Word and genuine community.
era2_para: As word spread and the congregation grew, the church moved into its first dedicated worship space in Charlottesville, allowing ministries and Sunday services to expand for the growing family of believers.
era3_para: Church Of The Living God found its lasting home at 2130 Berkmar Drive, a space that has since become a sanctuary of worship, fellowship, and outreach for the congregation and the wider community.
era4_para: New ministries took shape to meet the needs of a growing congregation and community — youth programs, community outreach, Bible studies, and pastoral care all flourished during this season.
era5_para: Today, Church Of The Living God continues to grow as a vibrant, multi-generational congregation devoted to worship, prayer, and service — carrying forward the same mission that started it all.
closing_para: Every chapter of this story has been written by ordinary people who said yes to God's call — and the next chapter includes you. Whether you've been here for decades or you're just now finding us, there's a place for your story in ours.
